evidence.title: diri README
evidence.locator: What you get; Install; Add an agent; License
evidence.finding: Native Rust/GPUI app running many coding agents with live status, sessions that outlive the app, worktree per task, built-in MCP server for agent-spawned agents, notes, schedules and folder triggers, computer use, SSH remote hosts; free AGPL-3.0, no account.

evidence.title: diri ROADMAP
evidence.finding: Direction: notes, Windows native build in progress, bigger swarms; boundaries: no account, no hosted relay, diagnostics can be turned off, agents not sandboxed.

evidence.title: diri LICENSE
evidence.finding: GNU AGPL-3.0; copyright 2026 Cristian Cretu and diri contributors.

evidence.title: Privacy notice
evidence.locator: Diagnostics; Where it goes; Your controls
evidence.finding: No account; diagnostics (crashes, hangs, timings, session ids, agent names, hashed folders) uploaded hourly by default to a project Cloudflare Worker, kept 30 days; terminal contents never recorded; Settings switch and DIRI_TELEMETRY=off.

evidence.title: Security model
evidence.finding: Not a sandbox: agents run with user privileges; worktrees are not a security boundary; SSH is the remote trust boundary with no relay.

evidence.title: Telemetry contract
evidence.finding: Local flight recorder spool with allowed fields only; upload separately controllable; DIRI_TELEMETRY=off disables recording; dev builds do not upload.

evidence.title: Account profiles
evidence.finding: Switch Claude Code or Codex login for every open tab keeping one conversation home; shows plan windows and resets.

evidence.title: Recipes and scheduled tasks
evidence.finding: Recipes (saved launches) implemented; document labels a scheduling proposal as not implemented while the release ships a schedule engine (see schedule.rs).

evidence.title: diri for iPhone
evidence.finding: SwiftUI client talks to diri-web on the Mac over HTTP; creates local or SSH sessions, sends prompts, answers questions, follows terminal output, reviews changes.

evidence.title: MCP tool catalog
evidence.finding: Tools: spawn_agent(s), fork_agent, submit_task(s), wait_for_task, wait_any, report_task, answer_task, cancel_task, schedule_agent, list/delete schedules, get_diff, integrate, create/list/remove_worktree, manage_agent (hibernate/wake/resume), release_agent, notes tools, browser, computer, test_run, layout/actions.

evidence.title: Engine MCP endpoint
evidence.finding: Engine serves MCP over loopback Streamable HTTP with per-session HMAC bearer token reaching the agent only through the PTY environment.

evidence.title: Schedule rules
evidence.finding: Five-field cron in local time; each occurrence claimed at most once; missed occurrences collapse to one catch-up run or are recorded missed.

evidence.title: Wake helper
evidence.finding: Privileged diri-wake-helper (approved in Login Items) schedules Mac wake for runs and can sleep the Mac again.

evidence.title: File triggers
evidence.finding: Folder watch triggers hand new files to an agent as batches; edits to existing paths never fire.

evidence.title: Resource governor
evidence.finding: Sweeps session process trees every 30 s for memory footprints and ports; per-session limit, sustained-idle freeze and global memory budget freeze only idle unattended sessions.

evidence.title: PR monitor
evidence.finding: Polls GitHub through gh for PRs captured as artifacts: state, review decision, mergeability, CI checks, comments, line stats; inert without gh.

evidence.title: Session artifacts
evidence.finding: Extracts and classifies URLs (PRs, Linear issues, previews, plain links) from a session terminal and OSC 8 hyperlinks into session artifacts.

evidence.title: Worktree health
evidence.finding: Local worktree inventory and conservative confirmed cleanup; no fetch or branch deletion.

evidence.title: Usage pricing estimates
evidence.finding: API-equivalent pricing estimates for transcript fallbacks, labelled estimates not billing; plan windows per account.

evidence.title: Attention tracking
evidence.finding: Single owner for inferred wait episodes and native request identities.

evidence.title: Agent manifests
evidence.finding: Manifests for aider, amp, antigravity, claude-code, cline, codex, copilot, cursor, devin, droid, gemini, grok, hermes, kilo, kimi, kiro, maki, opencode, pi, qoder, whipcode, generic and shell.

evidence.title: Phone access gateway
evidence.finding: App-lifetime phone gateway with persisted owner-only pairing token or Tailscale WhoIs identity with per-device revoke; no public bind.

evidence.title: diri install guide
evidence.locator: macOS; Linux beta; iPhone companion; Local data
evidence.finding: macOS 15+ universal signed and notarized DMG/Homebrew, self-updating; Linux beta on x86_64/arm64 Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 (not every release has packages, no auto-update, no iPhone/port forward); iPhone beta needs a signed build over Tailscale, no App Store.

evidence.title: diri sessions
evidence.locator: Status; Notifications; Persistence; Resume and fork
evidence.finding: Status from hooks (Claude Code), turn notify (Codex) or screen; macOS notifications with reply, inbox, jump to next waiting; sessions held by holder processes survive quit; resume and fork for Claude Code and Codex.

evidence.title: diri worktrees and review
evidence.locator: Give an agent its own worktree; Review panel; Pull requests and checks; Bring work back
evidence.finding: Agents/recipes/CLI create worktrees; Review panel with stage, discard, commit; PR check status; integrate merges helper branches; handoff sheet; worktree cleanup list.

evidence.title: diri schedules and recipes
evidence.locator: Create a schedule; Missed runs; Wake the Mac
evidence.finding: Schedules (once, daily, weekdays, hourly) owned by the Engine with catch-up up to 12 hours, keep-awake and wake options; recipes as saved launches; repeated runs reuse one tab.

evidence.title: diri accounts and usage
evidence.finding: Saved Claude Code and Codex profiles, switching, plan limits and estimated cost from transcripts.

evidence.title: diri MCP server
evidence.locator: What agents can do; Set up
evidence.finding: Built-in MCP lets Claude Code, Codex and Cursor start and coordinate agents, assign tracked tasks, review diffs and merge branches; other agents can connect manually.

evidence.title: diri supported agents
evidence.finding: 21 agents plus shell with status source, resume, fork, quick approve, MCP and hooks per agent.

evidence.title: diri remote hosts
evidence.locator: What you need; How it works; Persistence
evidence.finding: SSH hosts (Linux x86_64/arm64, macOS Apple silicon) with uploaded diri-remote helper, no tmux/sudo; sessions survive disconnects on most hosts; no result survives host reboot; one window controls a session.

evidence.title: diri security
evidence.locator: MCP authority and lineage; Remote hosts
evidence.finding: Delegation limits: 3 levels deep and 16 live children per session by default; delegated agents write only to parent and children; every write needs a live session identity.
